examples.en: My cousin lives in Bukhara.
examples.uz: Amakivachcham Buxoroda yashaydi.

examples.en: My cousin and I grew up in the same street but barely speak now.
examples.uz: Amakivachcham bilan bir koʻchada katta boʻlganmiz, lekin hozir deyarli gaplashmaymiz.

examples.en: I usually get up at seven.
examples.uz: Men odatda soat yettida turaman.

examples.en: These things usually turn out to be simpler than they first look.
examples.uz: Bunday narsalar odatda birinchi qaraganda koʻringanidan soddaroq boʻlib chiqadi.

examples.en: I usually wear jeans.
examples.uz: Men odatda jinsi shim kiyaman.

examples.en: These jeans have lasted longer than anything else I own.
examples.uz: Bu jinsi shim menda boshqa hamma narsadan uzoqroq chidadi.

examples.en: All my friends are here.
examples.uz: Hamma doʻstlarim shu yerda.

examples.en: All of the people we interviewed said they would do it again.
examples.uz: Biz suhbatlashgan odamlarning hammasi buni yana qilishini aytdi.

examples.en: I think you're right.
examples.uz: Menimcha, siz haqsiz.

examples.en: I'd thought about it for weeks before I said anything.
examples.uz: Men bu haqda bir narsa deyishimdan oldin haftalab oʻylagandim.

examples.en: The journey takes three hours.
examples.uz: Safar uch soat davom etadi.

examples.en: The journey takes half the time it used to since the new road opened.
examples.uz: Yangi yoʻl ochilgandan beri safar avvalgisidan ikki baravar kam vaqt oladi.

examples.en: The weather is great in May.
examples.uz: Mayda havo ajoyib boʻladi.

examples.en: By May it was obvious that the plan wouldn't work.
examples.uz: Mayga borib reja ishlamasligi ayon boʻldi.

examples.en: I don't know the answer.
examples.uz: Men javobni bilmayman.

examples.en: I've known her long enough to tell when she's worried.
examples.uz: Men uni xavotirda ekanini bilib oladigan darajada uzoq vaqtdan beri taniyman.

examples.en: She is a good dancer.
examples.uz: U yaxshi raqqosa.

examples.en: She trained as a dancer for twelve years before an injury ended it.
examples.uz: U oʻn ikki yil raqqosa boʻlib shugʻullandi, jarohat esa bunga chek qoʻydi.

examples.en: We buy vegetables at the local market.
examples.uz: Biz sabzavotni mahalliy bozordan olamiz.

examples.en: The local council has promised to repair the road by spring.
examples.uz: Mahalliy kengash yoʻlni bahorgacha taʼmirlashga vaʼda berdi.

examples.en: We live on the fifth floor.
examples.uz: Biz beshinchi qavatda yashaymiz.

examples.en: This is the fifth time he's promised and the fifth time he's forgotten.
examples.uz: Bu uning beshinchi marta vaʼda berishi va beshinchi marta unutishi.

examples.en: I'd like some soup.
examples.uz: Menga shoʻrva bering.

examples.en: The soup tastes better the next day, which is true of most of them.
examples.uz: Shoʻrva ertasiga mazaliroq boʻladi, bu koʻpchiligiga tegishli.

examples.en: Do exercise 3 on page 10.
examples.uz: 10-betdagi 3-mashqni bajaring.

examples.en: Half an hour of exercise a day made more difference than she expected.
examples.uz: Kuniga yarim soat mashq u kutganidan koʻra koʻproq natija berdi.

examples.en: Visit our website.
examples.uz: Saytimizga kiring.

examples.en: The website hasn't been updated since the company moved offices.
examples.uz: Kompaniya ofisni koʻchirgandan beri sayt yangilanmagan.

examples.en: Why are you late?
examples.uz: Nega kechikdingiz?

examples.en: Nobody could explain why it had taken so long.
examples.uz: Nega bunchalik koʻp vaqt ketganini hech kim tushuntira olmadi.

examples.en: The cow gives milk.
examples.uz: Sigir sut beradi.

examples.en: The farm keeps around two hundred cows and sells the milk locally.
examples.uz: Fermada ikki yuzga yaqin sigir bor, suti esa mahalliy sotiladi.

examples.en: My brother is very tall.
examples.uz: Akam juda baland boʻyli.

examples.en: The new building is twice as tall as anything around it.
examples.uz: Yangi bino atrofdagi hamma narsadan ikki baravar baland.

examples.en: I'm reading a good book.
examples.uz: Men yaxshi kitob oʻqiyapman.

examples.en: It's the kind of book you want to read again as soon as you finish it.
examples.uz: Bu shunday kitobki, tugatishingiz bilan yana oʻqigingiz keladi.

examples.en: I got a message from him.
examples.uz: Men undan xabar oldim.

examples.en: It gets harder to change careers the longer you leave it.
examples.uz: Kasbni oʻzgartirish qanchalik keyinga surilsa, shunchalik qiyinlashadi.

examples.en: Hey! How's it going?
examples.uz: Hoy! Ishlar qalay?

examples.en: Hey, could you give me a hand with this for a second?
examples.uz: Hoy, bir soniyaga bunda yordam bera olasizmi?

examples.en: My uncle has a farm.
examples.uz: Amakimning fermasi bor.

examples.en: The farm had been in trouble long before the drought.
examples.uz: Ferma qurgʻoqchilikdan ancha oldin ham qiyin ahvolda edi.

examples.en: Listen to the dialogue.
examples.uz: Dialogni tinglang.

examples.en: There has been no real dialogue between the two sides for months.
examples.uz: Ikki tomon oʻrtasida oylar davomida haqiqiy dialog boʻlmadi.

examples.en: I have a few friends here.
examples.uz: Mening bu yerda bir nechta doʻstim bor.

examples.en: Very few of the people who signed up actually turned up.
examples.uz: Roʻyxatdan oʻtganlarning juda kami haqiqatan ham keldi.

examples.en: I clean my room every Sunday.
examples.uz: Men har yakshanba xonamni tozalayman.

examples.en: The kitchen had been cleaned so thoroughly that it smelled of nothing at all.
examples.uz: Oshxona shunchalik puxta tozalangan ediki, umuman hech qanday hid yoʻq edi.

examples.en: Swimming is good for your health.
examples.uz: Suzish sogʻliq uchun foydali.

examples.en: Swimming turned out to be the only thing that helped his back.
examples.uz: Suzish uning beliga yordam bergan yagona narsa boʻlib chiqdi.

examples.en: The classroom is on the first floor.
examples.uz: Sinf xonasi birinchi qavatda.

examples.en: The classroom was far too small for thirty students.
examples.uz: Sinf xonasi oʻttiz oʻquvchi uchun juda kichik edi.

examples.en: I'm from Uzbekistan.
examples.uz: Men Oʻzbekistondanman.

examples.en: Everything we know comes from a single source, which worries me.
examples.uz: Biz bilgan hamma narsa bitta manbadan keladi, bu meni xavotirga soladi.

examples.en: It was cold. However, we went out.
examples.uz: Havo sovuq edi. Biroq biz tashqariga chiqdik.

examples.en: The idea is a good one. However, nobody has worked out who will pay.
examples.uz: Gʻoya yaxshi. Biroq kim toʻlashini hech kim hal qilmagan.

examples.en: Look at the stars!
examples.uz: Yulduzlarga qarang!

examples.en: You can see far more stars here than anywhere near the city.
examples.uz: Bu yerda shahar atrofidagi har qanday joydan koʻra koʻproq yulduz koʻrinadi.

examples.en: Try this cake!
examples.uz: Bu tortni tatib koʻring!

examples.en: We tried everything we could think of before asking for help.
examples.uz: Biz yordam soʻrashdan oldin oʻylab topgan hamma narsani sinab koʻrdik.

examples.en: Vegetables are healthy.
examples.uz: Sabzavotlar foydali.

examples.en: Eating healthy food is easier when you plan the week in advance.
examples.uz: Haftani oldindan rejalashtirsangiz, sogʻlom ovqatlanish osonroq.

examples.en: I love Uzbek cooking.
examples.uz: Men oʻzbek pazandachiligini yaxshi koʻraman.

examples.en: Her cooking is the main reason everyone wants to be invited.
examples.uz: Uning pazandachiligi hamma taklif qilinishni istashining asosiy sababi.

examples.en: See you on Friday.
examples.uz: Juma kuni koʻrishamiz.

examples.en: Nothing ever gets decided on a Friday afternoon.
examples.uz: Juma kuni tushdan keyin hech qachon hech narsa hal boʻlmaydi.

examples.en: Imagine you are on a beach.
examples.uz: Tasavvur qiling, siz plyajdasiz.

examples.en: I can't imagine living anywhere else after all these years.
examples.uz: Shuncha yildan keyin boshqa joyda yashashni tasavvur qila olmayman.

examples.en: What age is your son?
examples.uz: Oʻgʻlingiz necha yoshda?

examples.en: At the age of sixteen she was already working to support her family.
examples.uz: Oʻn olti yoshida u oilasini boqish uchun allaqachon ishlardi.

examples.en: The shop closes at eleven.
examples.uz: Doʻkon soat oʻn birda yopiladi.

examples.en: The train doesn't get in until eleven, so don't wait up.
examples.uz: Poyezd oʻn birgacha kelmaydi, shuning uchun kutib oʻtirmang.

examples.en: Try to be positive.
examples.uz: Ijobiy boʻlishga harakat qiling.

examples.en: The response has been overwhelmingly positive so far.
examples.uz: Hozircha javob asosan ijobiy boʻldi.

examples.en: I have a good feeling about this.
examples.uz: Menda bu haqda yaxshi tuygʻu bor.

examples.en: I had the feeling she wasn't telling me everything.
examples.uz: Menda u menga hammasini aytmayotgandek tuygʻu bor edi.

examples.en: Many people live in this city.
examples.uz: Bu shaharda koʻp odam yashaydi.

examples.en: People tend to remember how you treated them, not what you said.
examples.uz: Odamlar nima deganingizni emas, ularga qanday munosabatda boʻlganingizni eslab qolishadi.

examples.en: We moved to a new flat.
examples.uz: Biz yangi kvartiraga koʻchdik.

examples.en: They moved three times in two years before settling here.
examples.uz: Ular bu yerga joylashgunicha ikki yilda uch marta koʻchishdi.

examples.en: Can I have some more tea?
examples.uz: Yana choy bersangiz boʻladimi?

examples.en: The more you explain it, the less sense it makes.
examples.uz: Buni qanchalik koʻp tushuntirsangiz, shunchalik tushunarsiz boʻlib boradi.

examples.en: They bought a new house.
examples.uz: Ular yangi uy sotib olishdi.

examples.en: The house has been empty since the family moved away.
examples.uz: Oila koʻchib ketgandan beri uy boʻsh turibdi.

examples.en: Dear Anna, thank you for your letter.
examples.uz: Hurmatli Anna, xatingiz uchun rahmat.

examples.en: Dear Mr Karimov, I am writing with regard to your application.
examples.uz: Hurmatli Karimov janoblari, arizangiz yuzasidan yozyapman.

examples.en: The bank is between the shop and the cafe.
examples.uz: Bank doʻkon bilan kafe oʻrtasida.

examples.en: The agreement was reached after long talks between the two companies.
examples.uz: Kelishuvga ikki kompaniya oʻrtasidagi uzoq muzokaralardan keyin erishildi.

examples.en: No problem!
examples.uz: Muammo yoʻq!

examples.en: The problem isn't the machine; it's that nobody was trained to use it.
examples.uz: Muammo mashinada emas; hech kim undan foydalanishga oʻrgatilmagan.

examples.en: I'm learning English.
examples.uz: Men ingliz tilini oʻrganyapman.

examples.en: She learned to drive at fifty and now drives everywhere.
examples.uz: U ellik yoshida mashina haydashni oʻrgandi va endi hamma joyga oʻzi haydab boradi.

examples.en: I love Italian food.
examples.uz: Men italyan ovqatini yaxshi koʻraman.

examples.en: Food prices have risen faster than wages for three years running.
examples.uz: Uch yil ketma-ket ovqat narxi maoshdan tezroq oshdi.

examples.en: She wants to be a scientist.
examples.uz: U olim boʻlmoqchi.

examples.en: The scientists had warned about this for over a decade.
examples.uz: Olimlar bu haqda oʻn yildan ortiq ogohlantirib kelishgandi.

examples.en: Birds can fly.
examples.uz: Qushlar ucha oladi.

examples.en: She'd never flown before and was more curious than frightened.
examples.uz: U ilgari hech qachon uchmagandi va qoʻrqqanidan koʻra qiziqqan edi.

examples.en: Can we have the bill, please?
examples.uz: Iltimos, hisobni olsak boʻladimi?

examples.en: We asked for the bill twice before anyone brought it.
examples.uz: Kimdir olib kelgunicha biz hisobni ikki marta soʻradik.

examples.en: We had a wonderful time.
examples.uz: Biz ajoyib vaqt oʻtkazdik.

examples.en: It was a wonderful idea that nobody had the money to carry out.
examples.uz: Bu ajoyib gʻoya edi, lekin uni amalga oshirishga hech kimda pul yoʻq edi.

examples.en: My mother is forty.
examples.uz: Onam qirq yoshda.

examples.en: She started again from nothing at forty and did better than before.
examples.uz: U qirq yoshida yoʻqdan qayta boshladi va avvalgisidan yaxshiroq natijaga erishdi.

examples.en: What is your favourite band?
examples.uz: Sevimli musiqiy guruhingiz qaysi?

examples.en: The band had been playing together for years before anyone noticed them.
examples.uz: Guruh kimdir ularni sezguncha yillar davomida birga chalib yurgandi.

examples.en: The keys are in my bag.
examples.uz: Kalitlar sumkamda.

examples.en: We'll be in touch as soon as there's any news.
examples.uz: Biror xabar boʻlishi bilan aloqaga chiqamiz.

examples.en: Writing is difficult for me.
examples.uz: Yozish men uchun qiyin.

examples.en: Get it in writing, or it never happened.
examples.uz: Buni yozma olib qoʻying, boʻlmasa u hech qachon boʻlmagan hisoblanadi.

examples.en: Enjoy your meal!
examples.uz: Yoqimli ishtaha!

examples.en: He enjoys the work far more now that he's not in charge of it.
examples.uz: U endi ishga javobgar boʻlmagani uchun undan ancha koʻproq zavqlanadi.

examples.en: I'm reading a book about history.
examples.uz: Men tarix haqida kitob oʻqiyapman.

examples.en: The history of the building is more interesting than the building itself.
examples.uz: Binoning tarixi binoning oʻzidan qiziqarliroq.

examples.en: I speak a little English.
examples.uz: Men ozgina ingliz tilida gaplashaman.

examples.en: We had very little time, so we did what we could.
examples.uz: Bizda juda oz vaqt bor edi, shuning uchun qoʻlimizdan kelganini qildik.

examples.en: I sent you a message.
examples.uz: Men sizga xabar yubordim.

examples.en: I got your message, but by then it was already too late.
examples.uz: Xabaringizni oldim, lekin oʻshanda allaqachon kech edi.

examples.en: The dog is eating its food.
examples.uz: It oʻz ovqatini yeyapti.

examples.en: The company has changed its name twice in five years.
examples.uz: Kompaniya besh yilda nomini ikki marta oʻzgartirdi.

examples.en: I want to buy a new phone.
examples.uz: Men yangi telefon sotib olmoqchiman.

examples.en: They bought the house before they'd even seen the garden.
examples.uz: Ular bogʻni koʻrmasdan turiboq uyni sotib olishdi.

examples.en: He is a good football player.
examples.uz: U yaxshi futbol oʻyinchisi.

examples.en: Two of their best players were injured before the season started.
examples.uz: Mavsum boshlanishidan oldin ularning eng yaxshi ikki oʻyinchisi jarohat oldi.

examples.en: I'll be there in half an hour.
examples.uz: Men yarim soatda yetib boraman.

examples.en: Half of what he says turns out to be true, which is the problem.
examples.uz: U aytganlarning yarmi rost boʻlib chiqadi, muammo ham shunda.

examples.en: They have a small dog.
examples.uz: Ularning kichik iti bor.

examples.en: A small change in the wording made all the difference.
examples.uz: Soʻz tanlashdagi kichik oʻzgarish hal qiluvchi boʻldi.

examples.en: What's the difference between them?
examples.uz: Ular orasidagi farq nima?

examples.en: The difference between the two versions is barely noticeable.
examples.uz: Ikki versiya orasidagi farq deyarli sezilmaydi.

examples.en: Let's walk in the park.
examples.uz: Keling, bogʻda sayr qilamiz.

examples.en: The park was built on land that used to be a railway yard.
examples.uz: Bogʻ ilgari temir yoʻl hovlisi boʻlgan yerda qurilgan.

examples.en: My room is upstairs.
examples.uz: Xonam tepada.

examples.en: The noise from upstairs had been going on since midnight.
examples.uz: Tepadan kelayotgan shovqin yarim tundan beri davom etardi.

examples.en: Put the books in the box.
examples.uz: Kitoblarni qutiga soling.

examples.en: We found a box of old photographs while we were clearing out the attic.
examples.uz: Biz chordoqni tozalayotganimizda bir quti eski suratlarni topdik.

examples.en: Bye! See you tomorrow.
examples.uz: Xayr! Ertaga koʻrishamiz.

examples.en: She said bye without looking up from her phone.
examples.uz: U telefonidan koʻz uzmay xayr dedi.

examples.en: What type of music do you like?
examples.uz: Qanday tur musiqani yoqtirasiz?

examples.en: It's the type of mistake that only shows up much later.
examples.uz: Bu ancha keyin bilinadigan turdagi xato.

examples.en: What is the main idea of the text?
examples.uz: Matnning asosiy gʻoyasi nima?

examples.en: The main problem isn't the price; it's that nobody trusts them.
examples.uz: Asosiy muammo narxda emas; ularga hech kim ishonmaydi.

examples.en: My grandmother grows tomatoes.
examples.uz: Buvim pomidor yetishtiradi.

examples.en: The town has grown so fast that the schools can't take everyone.
examples.uz: Shahar shunchalik tez oʻsdiki, maktablar hammani sigʻdira olmayapti.

examples.en: I grew up in a small town.
examples.uz: Men kichik shaharchada katta boʻlganman.

examples.en: The whole town turned out, which hadn't happened in years.
examples.uz: Butun shaharcha koʻchaga chiqdi, bu yillar davomida boʻlmagan edi.

examples.en: It costs fifty cents.
examples.uz: Bu ellik sent turadi.

examples.en: The price went up by only a few cents, but people noticed straight away.
examples.uz: Narx atigi bir necha sentga oshdi, lekin odamlar darhol sezishdi.

examples.en: Can I take a photo?
examples.uz: Surat olsam boʻladimi?

examples.en: The photo was taken years before either of them became famous.
examples.uz: Surat ikkalasi mashhur boʻlishidan yillar oldin olingan.
